name: Ogawa Kazuki
source:
A brainy kid with a knack for fixing gadgets. He can be somewhat introverted, but he cares deeply for his big sister, [url=http://vndb.org/c2032]Naoko[/url]. One sure way to upset him is teasing him about his height!
